text: Four SpaceX tokens trade on Solana. They look identical in a wallet.
They confer four different legal relationships, and nothing tells you which one you hold.
Claim reads every tokenized equity on the chain and grades the claim behind it.
Backpack is real shares in regulated custody, portable to a brokerage. Grade A.
Backed is a Jersey certificate, with a delegate that can take it from your wallet. Grade C.
Buy a company, and Claim picks the token. A hundred and fifty four can be reached by a swap.
For eighty three of them, the strongest claim is not the one you can buy. Claim says so before you sign.
Claim builds the swap and hands it to your wallet. It never holds a key and never submits.
Scan any wallet. Every position graded, worst claim first.
The same verdict, free, over a public A P I.
